notes.title: Dear Guests! Postponing release and news about demo!
notes.content:
[h3]Our kitchen is a little overwhelmed, and the main dish — [i]Kill Ralph[/i] — needs more time to be cooked to perfection.
That means your order (the full release) will now be served on [b]October 22th[/b].
[/h3][h3]But don’t worry, we won’t leave you hungry!
On [b]September 28th[/b], we’ll bring you a little appetizer — the [b]demo version[/b] — so you can get a taste while waiting for the main course.
[/h3][h3]Thank you for your patience and for staying with us — things are about to get spicy!
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489894/39bba1f792837dd7eab935b60ac702378d74b157.png"][/img][/p]
